lines.text: Easy, easy. No need to shout. Folks might think we had business.
I know everyone on this Green. I don't know you.
Jasper Crane. Dealer in this and that. Mostly that.
No coin, no questions. You bring me what the frost leaves lying about, and I find you something useful. Fair prices. Ask anyone.
There's nobody back here to ask.
Then you'll have to take my word. Most do.
Back again. Curiosity's a fine thing. It's kept me fed for years.
We never met, of course. But since we haven't, what can I do for you?
Stones go cold, prices go up. I've seen it before. Not here, mind. Somewhere with worse manners.
Heard something howled up at the wall. Bad for the village. Wonderful for trade.
Tin's holding up nicely. Thanks for not asking.
Spread it out, then. Don't mind the light. There isn't any.
Course. I'll be right here. Or I won't.
